upvoteCount.description: Qualifying upvotes from accounts on this network plus the item's bridged upvote total from federated platforms

recentUpvoters.description: Up to 3 most recent qualifying voters on this network, newest first; absent when there are none, for example when every upvote is bridged. Newest is by when this AppView indexed the vote, not the vote record's createdAt.

preferences.description: Notification reasons enabled for the authenticated account.

mention.description: Receive mentions in posts and comments.
